items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was a player sort of like Eddie Stanky. That kind of player.

ctx.x: So you were the best in North Carolina...
Well, I was one of the best. We had some good players, but I was one of the best. I could have easily made it. I was a player sort of like Eddie Stanky. That kind of player.
